about: Smalltown Boy as our crew performs it: everything a version with other characters is made from. The source is two cats standing up, mirrored and started half a second in, so its first shot is the cover. Each shot has the cats' motion (their keypoints from AnimalPose, and the skeleton rebuilt with the cat build), its first frame with the crew (the cover for the first shot, drawn from it for the others) and its prompt with each role's slot ({Lead} is that role's name and look, {LeadName} and {PartnerName} the names). The takes run shot-swap-dev.json with the pose as a ready-made control and the vocals frozen in; only the first two shots are sung.

sound.note: The trend's own song (its vocals drove the mouths, its mix went under the cut) is the original recording and is not shipped: our version's preview plays silent. A version made from this recipe follows a track Mixer makes in the trend's feel. A recipe that names a sound ("mix" for the cut, "vocals" for the mouths) uses it instead.

beats.text: Praline sings up close, paws at the cheeks; Meringue dances behind
Meringue gasps up close, paws on the head; Praline dances behind
Side by side, paws up, they dance
From the floor: side steps, paws high
Both lunge at the lens, paws swiping

shots.prompt: Close shot in a sunny cozy kitchen with sage-teal cabinets, hanging plants and warm morning light. {Lead}, stands right in front of the camera with both front paws raised beside the cheeks and sings a long high note, mouth wide open, swaying to the beat, then reaches both front paws toward the camera. Behind on the rug, {Partner}, stands on the hind legs and dances, bouncing and waving the front paws. Polished 3D animated feature-film style. An upbeat 1980s synth-pop song with a high falsetto voice. {LeadName} sings.
